name: Plank Rotation
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and feet slightly apart.
Shift your weight onto one hand and pivot your feet as you turn your hips and chest to the side.
Reach your free arm toward the ceiling, then turn back and place that hand beneath your shoulder.
Repeat on the opposite side, alternating directions.
tips: Keep the supporting shoulder over your wrist as you turn.
Rotate your hips and rib cage together so your lower back stays supported.
